A threat actor group on a hacker forum claims to have dumped databases from Follow the Money (ftm[.]nl), the Dutch investigative journalism platform covering corruption and financial crime.

item.description:
Airliners across Europe were forced into unplanned landings Thursday morning by bomb threats, the latest in a series of threats against flights on the continent.

In Bulgaria, officials counted 3 emergency landings. Planes flying from Copenhagen and Madrid came down in Sofia, the interior minister told broadcaster bTV.

Aer Lingus flight EI402 from Dublin to Rome was diverted as a security precaution. It landed safely at Evreux airport, 100 km west of Paris, the Irish airline confirmed in a statement.

Belgian media identified a Polish LOT airliner as the plane forced down at Brussels' Zaventem airport.

A Finnair plane from Helsinki was escorted safely to its scheduled landing in Rome by the Italian air force, a source close to the matter told Reuters.

Reuters

item.description:
🇺🇸 🚨 USA: WEALTHFRONT CUSTOMER DATABASE ALLEGEDLY UP FOR SALE, 800K RECORDS

A threat actor on a Russian-language dark web forum is advertising a database they say belongs to Wealthfront, the US robo-advisor and fintech platform.

According to the listing:
* About 800,000 customer records
* Names, emails, phone numbers, birthdates and home addresses
* Breach date given as November 1, 2026
* Asking price: $800

The claim has not been independently verified, and Wealthfront has not commented.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Investment-platform customers are prime targets for account-takeover and "support call" scams. If you use Wealthfront, expect convincing phishing using your real details, never share codes by phone, and keep MFA on. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

According to the claim:
* Internal corporate documents

* A full email dump from at least one employee
* Shared for free via a cloud storage link

item.title: 🇫🇷 🚨 FRANCE: 20M+ RECORDS FROM 34 FRENCH SPORTS FEDERATIONS AND BODIES ALLEGEDLY DUMPED A threat actor on a dark web forum has released a 5.9...
item.description:
🇫🇷 🚨 FRANCE: 20M+ RECORDS FROM 34 FRENCH SPORTS FEDERATIONS AND BODIES ALLEGEDLY DUMPED

A threat actor on a dark web forum has released a 5.9 GB data dump (uncompressed) that they claim covers more than 20 million records from 34 French sports federations and related organizations.

Entities named in the claim include:
* French Swimming Federation (ffnatation[.]fr)
* French Karate Federation (ffkarate[.]fr)
* French Hospital Federation (fhf[.]fr)

The files are in CSV and JSONL format and are being distributed to forum members for platform points. This is much larger than the October leak of about a dozen federations' licensing data we reported, and it may partly overlap with it. It has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The spread across 34 bodies points to a shared third-party platform rather than 34 separate hacks. Sports licence data often covers minors and medical-certificate details, so members and parents should watch for phishing posing as their federation or club. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #France #DataLeak #Sports #ThreatIntelligence

item.description:
🇵🇭 🚨 PHILIPPINES: PAGCOR "RESTRICTED PERSONS" GAMBLING BAN DATABASE ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor on a dark web forum has leaked a database they say is the National Database of Restricted Persons (NDRP) of the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR), the state gaming regulator.

The NDRP lists people barred from PAGCOR-authorized gaming venues and is used by licensed operators to screen patrons. According to the claim:
* Records on more than half a million restricted individuals
* Personal details of people legally banned from gambling
* A significant number of government officials among them

PAGCOR has said in similar past incidents that such data usually came from third-party licensees rather than its own systems. This claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Even if the source is a licensee, a list naming people banned from gambling, including officials, is a blackmail and social-engineering goldmine. Listed individuals should be alert to extortion attempts. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

VIDEO | Delhi: CTI Chairman Brijesh Goyal says, "The Supreme Court, two days ago, permitted the bursting of green firecrackers in Delhi on November 7 and 8. The CTI welcomes this decision. However, the biggest problem at present is that several firecracker traders in Delhi have met the CTI and raised their concerns. The main issue is that the permission has been granted only two days in advance. There are around 180 permanent licence holders in Delhi. They are required to get their licences renewed every year from the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO), whose office is in Faridabad. After that, they also need clearances from the DM's office, the Fire Department and the DCP's office. We are receiving calls and messages from traders saying that many of them have still not received their licences. The biggest concern is that they are allowed to sell firecrackers only until November 6. If they have not received their licences yet, when will they complete the licensing process and start selling? Another major problem is that Delhi does not have any firecracker industry or manufacturing units. All the firecrackers supplied to Delhi come from cities in the NCR."

item.description:
🇰🇷 🚨 SOUTH KOREA: DEFENSE CONTRACTOR NEXTWILL ALLEGEDLY BREACHED, 536 GB OF EW AND RADAR DATA CLAIMED

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to have stolen 536 GB of proprietary technical data from Nextwill Co., Ltd., a South Korean defense contractor that works on electronic warfare (EW), radar and counter-drone systems.

The actor claims the data includes:
* Technical documents and EW system specifications
* Radar equipment data
* Material tied to systems used by the South Korean military and partners such as Hanwha Systems and STX Engine

The actor is soliciting buyers. None of this has been independently verified, and Nextwill has not commented.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, this is a national-security concern, not just a corporate leak: EW, jamming and counter-UAS specs are high-value targets for state actors. Defense partners that shared project data with Nextwill should review access and watch for follow-on targeting. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to have leaked a database tied to Argensoft, an Argentine developer of management software for private clinics and medical offices, and is giving it away for free.

The allegedly exposed data includes:
• Full names and sex
• DNI (national ID) numbers, age and date of birth

STORY | MCD suspends two officials after building collapse in Old Delhi's Chawri Bazaar

The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) on Thursday suspended two junior level officials, including an assistant engineer and a junior engineer, in connection with the collapse of a building under construction in Old Delhi’s Chawri Bazaar that killed two people and left four others injured.

In separate office orders, the Deputy Commissioner of the Old Delhi Zone placed the two officials under suspension with immediate effect. The orders cited a prima facie case of serious negligence in the discharge of their duties.

“In view of the recent incident and the developments arising therefrom, and considering the prima facie case of severe dereliction of duty, you are hereby placed under suspension with immediate effect, pending further inquiry,” the orders stated.

The action comes after a three-storey building under construction collapsed in Gali Sitara near Chawri Bazaar Metro station around 9.50 am on Thursday.

item.description:
STORY | CM Rekha Gupta orders inquiry into Chawri Bazar building collapse, FIR against contractor

Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Thursday ordered an inquiry into the collapse of a three-storey building under construction in Old Delhi's Chawri Bazar, which claimed two lives and left four others injured, and directed the registration of an FIR against the contractor.

The chief minister also ordered the immediate suspension of the concerned junior engineer (JE) and assistant engineer (AE) in connection with the incident.

She directed officials to ensure the best possible medical treatment for the injured and provide immediate ex-gratia assistance to the affected families.

"Stringent action will be taken against those found responsible, in accordance with the law," the chief minister said.

The building collapsed around 9.50 am in Gali Sitara, near the Chawri Bazar Metro station, police said.

Why he was pushed away from Rahul Gandhi? So Rahul Gandhi should have a debate with Shivakumar ji, Jarkiholi and should clarify what is the position of SIR in Karnataka. Whether the leaders of Karnataka were speaking the truth or whether he is speaking the truth. Then Rahul Gandhi ji should have a debate with Ms. Shilpa. I saw the video of West Karnataka MLC elections recently. It was held on ballot, no? He wants the ballot. It was held in ballot. Ballot chori was happening. The lady, who is not a graduate, with all due respect to the lady, Ms. Shilpa was casting a vote, a proxy vote for the District President's wife. If I'm not wrong, please clarify and correct me."

item.description:
VIDEO | During the 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' padyatra in Karnal, Union Home Minister Amit Shah (@AmitShah) says, "Rahul Baba, where was the SIR in 2014? Even then, your party was completely wiped out. Where was the SIR in 2019? You lost that election too. There was no SIR in 2024 either, yet you still lost. There was no SIR in Haryana, nor was there one in Maharashtra. You lost everywhere, and now you claim that 13 crore votes have been deleted. Today, from this very platform, I want to challenge Rahul Ji. You challenge Narendra Modi Ji to a debate? Rahul Ji, there is no need for Modi Ji to be involved. If you want a discussion, simply write a letter to Modi Ji. We are ready to convene a special session of Parliament to discuss the SIR issue. We can hold the entire discussion there. Stop spreading lies!"

(Source: Union Home Minister Amit Shah YT)

#LoktantraBachaoArajaktaHatao
